name: Tee and cross blocks
function: Forged blocks with three or four union connections that split or combine treating lines, used at the goat head, the manifold, and where relief or bleed lines branch off.

tabs.overview: Blocks are machined from a single forging with integral union ends. Flow that turns inside a tee erodes the wall opposite the inlet; target tees with a blanked run are used where the turn is sharp.
tabs.engineering: Rated with the iron; wall-thickness inspection points are marked on the erosion side.
tabs.safety: A tee is a line-of-fire item on two or three axes; restrain every branch.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Restraints and whip checks on iron; exclusion zone around pressurized lines.
Tree saver in the wellhead; valves fully open or fully closed only; iron inspection.
